description: This Java source file defines the class MyReceiver, which implements the OnReceiveContentListener interface in an Android project. It handles incoming content, specifically URIs, by processing images and other content types, storing images locally, and providing user feedback through toasts.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: A class implementing OnReceiveContentListener that processes incoming content URIs, storing images locally and providing user notifications for other content types.

methods.name: onReceiveContent
methods.description: Handles the incoming ContentInfo, splitting URIs from other content and delegating processing.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Processes content URIs asynchronously, storing images locally, and updating the UI with new attachments or showing messages for other content types.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Retrieves content size and type, then displays this information in a toast message.
